text:
naveen: Heads up — customers on Private control plane reported audit entries missing for admin activity after the RBAC refactor deployed last night. KMS rotation events happened around the same time. Who's on this?

security-bot: Alert: audit-exporter in priv-controlplane-eu-west-2 reported exporter_status=FAILED (kms:Decrypt error) 2026-11-02T07:21:14Z

sara: pulling logs now. which tenant?

naveen: tenant tc-47. User noticed role binding change for 'priv-admin' but there's no audit trail for the binder event.

ashley: that PR that landed was the role/perm refactor (PR #1768) — it changed the default role mapping and touched the controlplane startup order.

mike: I see the trace: exporter tried to initialize, then KMS key rotated, alias pointed to new key. CloudTrail shows KMS:Decrypt DENY for service account at 07:21:12 UTC. Exporter exited at 07:21:14.

security-bot: CloudTrail excerpt:
```
2026-11-02T07:21:12Z KMS Decrypt Denied keyId=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:1111:key/abcd1234 principal=svcacct-priv-audit@redwood svc=KMS action=Decrypt
```

ashley: hmm — remember we put the exporter pod to rely on KMS alias redwood-priv-audit. If alias swap happened before key policy included the exporter service account, Decrypt will fail.

sara: confirmed key rotation event: alias update at 07:21:10. Key policy update for new key at 07:22:00 (race). So exporter booted in between.

mike: temporary mitigation: infra-oncall, can you restart the exporter with the older key alias pinned or roll back the RBAC change?

infra-oncall: rolled back the RBAC refactor on priv-ctrlplane-eu-west-2 (rolled back deploy revision r2026.11.01-1768). Restarted audit-exporter: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/audit-exporter -n priv-controlplane`. Exporter came up at 07:26:37 and started shipping entries.

naveen: good. We need a short remediation checklist for compliance:
1) Rebind key policy to include svcacct-priv-audit on new key
2) Ensure alias swap is atomic only after key policy is in place
3) Add readiness probe to exporter that requires successful KMS decrypt before marking ready
4) Add alert for "no audit entries for controlplane-admin actions > 1m"

ashley: agree. Also add startup gating in the RBAC refactor: controlplane shouldn't apply role bindings until audit exporter is healthy.

mike: FYI I also saw a VPC allowlist update for the same tenant applied at 07:20:58 — probably unrelated but noted in timeline.

sara: compliance note: audit gap window = 2026-11-02T07:21:05Z -> 2026-11-02T07:26:37Z (~5m32s). Capture payloads we have cached and any out-of-band actions.

security-bot: Incident INC-2027 created: "priv ctlplane audit suppression during KMS rotation" assigned to eng-security.

naveen: I've added timeline + initial investigation to INC-2027 and assigned postmortem to ashley. Tagging @compliance and @oncall for awareness.

ashley: I'll own the fix for the RBAC startup gating and the exporter readiness. Plan: feature branch with init-order tests, then canary in eu-west-2.

infra-oncall: we've kept the rollback in place for eu-west-2 and will coordinate key policy update with KMS team at 09:00 UTC.

mike: quick note for future: add a pre-rotation check to ensure service principals exist in new key policy before alias switch.

naveen: thanks team — please drop any artifacts into INC-2027 and we can turn this into a short postmortem. :thumbsup:
